entries.basis: Scored as launched (GPT-5.4 mini, 17 Mar 2026, shipped with nano; this rubric is for mini): Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 48 at xhigh (nano 44), AA post of the launch (v4.0); 400k context; $0.75 in / $4.50 out per 1M = about $1.69 blended (nano $0.20/$1.25); text+image input. Coding null: OpenAI's Terminal-Bench 2.0 60.0% (mini) and AA's TerminalBench 52% are not Terminal-Bench 4.0. Speed null: OpenAI says 'more than 2x faster than GPT-5 mini' but no launch tok/s was opened (AA's current page reads 254.5 tok/s). (A review whose quote could not be re-verified was dropped.)
